name: M3_CRS025MI_AddItemGroup
description: Create item groups that classify items and control default forecasting and catch weight behavior. An item group acts as a common identity to group items, for example for selection, sorting, and forecast adjustments. You can store a description and an optional short name, link the group to a seasonal curve and a trend curve, and define tolerances for catch weight deviations. Seasonal and trend curves describe how quantities are distributed over the periods of a calendar year and how trends evolve, and catch weight tolerances control allowed variance when reporting catch weight items.

inputParameters.name: ITGR
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the item group to create.

inputParameters.name: TX40
inputParameters.description: Full description of the item group.

inputParameters.name: TX15
inputParameters.description: Short name of the item group, typically used in lists and overviews.

inputParameters.name: SECU
inputParameters.description: Seasonal curve that defines how demand for items in this group is distributed over the year.

inputParameters.name: TECU
inputParameters.description: Trend curve that defines how demand for items in this group changes over time.

inputParameters.name: TCWP
inputParameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation from expected weight for catch weight items in this group, expressed as a percentage.

inputParameters.name: TCWQ
inputParameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation from expected average weight for catch weight items in this group, expressed in weight units.
